title: Stationary Strings XII: Dark-Matter-Free Galactic Dynamics, the Meral Cosmic Acceleration Scale, SPARC Rotation Curves, and EHT Black-Hole Ring Evidence
description: First link of the Stationary Strings series (October 2026): Meral cosmic acceleration scale with no new calibration constant a_Meral = mu_s (1-eta) c H_0 and the string-loop radial acceleration relation with baryonic Tully-Fisher slope 4 (Theorem XII.1-XII.2, Tests T29-T30), Event Horizon Telescope black-hole ring saturation d_ring = 6 theta_g C_univ sqrt(1+mu_s/4) = 10.002404 theta_g for Sgr A* and M87* (Theorem XII.3, Test T31), and an independent 15-point cross-check. Full paper in Turkish and English. Tests T29-T31 run with the solver in the Paper V repository (stationary-strings-v).
